metadata.description: Connect your coding harness to your Wybe AI colleague. Sends only, redacted on your machine first; what comes back is your colleague's open questions.

plugins.name: wybe-connect
plugins.description: Feeds your Wybe AI colleague from Cursor: prompts and edited files (sessions:light), plus replies and tool I/O (sessions:full), redacted on your laptop. Sends only, and never reads what your colleague knows; the one thing that comes back is your colleague's open questions, shown at session start and at most one after a turn as a follow-up, for you to answer or not.
